analysis.note: Two replicates per group: exploratory inference. Significant tiles are fixed windows, not de novo DMRs.

annotation.annotation: UCSC ncbiRefSeqCurated/hg38; overlapping promoters and gene bodies; CpG island and 2kb shores
annotation.go: Exploratory hypergeometric ORA with BH across all eligible terms, using tested annotated genes as universe. RRBS CpG density and gene length bias are not corrected.
annotation.note: An overlapping gene is an association, not evidence of regulation or causality.
